name: Apache APISIX
author: Netlens
description: Shows the routes an Apache APISIX gateway publishes: host names, the upstream (also through a shared upstream or a service), redirects, whether a route is switched off, and the TLS certificates with their expiry date. Read-only: it only sends GET requests, with the key of the built-in viewer role.

info.title: Use the viewer key
info.text: APISIX's Admin API (port 9180) can change everything with the admin key. Netlens only needs the 'viewer' role, which can read but not change: in config.yaml under deployment.admin.admin_key keep one entry with role viewer and use its key here. Let the Admin API listen on a private address only (deployment.admin.admin_listen, allow_admin).
info.code:
deployment:
  admin:
    allow_admin: [192.168.0.0/24]
    admin_key:
      - name: viewer
        key: <a long random key>
        role: viewer

columns.label: APISIX host's own address
columns.help: The address of the machine APISIX runs on, when the Admin API is reached by name or as 127.0.0.1. Site checks are sent to it.
